load_coco_annotations: load COCO annotations from a JSON file and convert them to Detections objects with optional masks
save_coco_annotations: save a DetectionDataset to COCO format JSON annotations file with configurable mask approximation
coco_annotations_to_detections: convert COCO annotation dictionaries for an image into Detections objects with optional masks
detections_to_coco_annotations: convert Detections objects into COCO-formatted annotation dictionaries with polygon or RLE segmentation
get_coco_class_index_mapping: generate a mapping from sequential class indices to original COCO category ids from an annotations file
